notes:
More reliable unlocking: when your trial was extended, the app sometimes only
noticed hours later or not at all if the license server was slow to respond.
Now the app checks at startup, waits longer for the answer and retries every few
minutes while the trial reads as expired. The lock screen unlocks by itself as
soon as the extension arrives and now also shows available updates.

Your device is now recognised permanently, even when you switch between WiFi,
LAN or VPN.
